responsibility: This pipeline description models the N10 core family for the NDS32 scheduler. It declares automaton resources for integer and FPU pipelines, reservation timings for scalar, multiple-memory, DSP, divide, and floating-point instruction classes, and bypass guards describing MM-to-EX and FPU address dependencies, so instruction scheduling reflects the N10 microarchitecture rather than the simpler N7/N8/E8 or newer Graywolf/N13 models.
